text.description_html:
PDQ Friction Style Hold Open Arm

Fits PDQ American Eagle 3100 and PDQ American Eagle 3101 Door Closers.

Includes Parallel Arm Mounting Bracket. Can be mounted regular, top jamb or parallel arm.
Note: For Hold Open to function properly when regular or top jamb mounting the door closer, door must open a minimum of 90 degrees. When parallel mounting minimum door opening is 40 degrees

Also available: PDQ Thumb Turn Hold Open Arm.

Adjustable arm length and degree that the door is help open.

Available in Aluminum or Dark Bronze finish.
